capabilities: Detect writing issues like passive voice, weasel words, and wordy phrases
Flag lexical illusions, clichés, and E-Prime violations
Toggle checks per note via command palette or hotkey
Enable or disable individual checks in settings
Show suggestions automatically as you type
extras: Suggestions appear automatically while typing; checks can be toggled per note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in checks for prose quality, so weak style such as passive voice or filler words goes unnoticed while writing.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that integrates write good, a linter for English prose

summary: Prose linter that flags English writing issues like passive voice, weasel words, adverbs, wordy phrases, and clichés in notes.
